name: Microsoft Graph (Outlook)
description: Read, draft, and send Outlook mail and read calendar via Microsoft Graph using OAuth2 device-code or auth-code-PKCE flow against the host's Entra ID tenant.

tenantId.description: Entra ID tenant ID or domain (e.g. moe.gov.tt). Required.

clientId.description: Application (client) ID from the Entra ID app registration. Required.

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI registered in Entra (auth-code flow only). Default: http://localhost:53682/callback

authFlow.description: Sign-in flow. device-code is best for headless/server hosts; auth-code-pkce for the desktop app.

scopes.description: Delegated Graph scopes requested at sign-in. Tenant admin must consent to scopes touching tenant data.

tenantId.label: Entra Tenant
tenantId.help: GUID or verified domain (e.g. moe.gov.tt). Provided by the tenant admin.

clientId.label: App (client) ID
clientId.help: From the App registration in the Entra admin portal.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.help: Must exactly match a redirect URI on the app registration.
